entries.name: Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)
entries.use_for: Add production-grade engineering skills (specs, TDD, review, CI, performance) to coding agents.
entries.why: Broad, well-structured engineering skill set; 107k stars and 93 contributors.

entries.name: Anthropic Agent Skills
entries.use_for: Official Anthropic skill collection: frontend design, skill creation, MCP building, document handling and more.
entries.why: The reference implementation of the Agent Skills format, maintained by Anthropic and among the most-installed skills.

license_verified.note: Per-skill licenses: most skills are Apache-2.0; the docx, pdf, pptx and xlsx skills are source-available (read-only, do not fork).

entries.name: archify
entries.use_for: Turn an idea, plan or codebase into an interactive architecture diagram
entries.why: About 158k skills.sh installs; works across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with a companion review skill.

entries.name: Awesome GitHub Copilot
entries.use_for: Official GitHub collection of skills, prompts, instructions and custom agents usable across coding agents
entries.why: GitHub-maintained, community-contributed library of hundreds of skills and agents; widely installed via skills.sh

entries.name: Azure skills
entries.use_for: Official Microsoft skills for preparing, deploying, diagnosing and securing apps on Azure
entries.why: Official vendor pack with ~560k installs per core skill on skills.sh; covers Foundry, deploy, diagnostics and storage

entries.name: caveman
entries.use_for: Cut agent output tokens with terse caveman-style responses, commits and reviews
entries.why: Most-installed skill pack on skills.sh (~578k installs for the core skill) with commit/review/compress variants.

entries.name: Claude Code official plugins
entries.use_for: Install vetted Claude Code plugins from Anthropic's official marketplace directory.
entries.why: Anthropic-managed directory of curated plugins; the default trusted source for Claude Code.

entries.name: claude-hud
entries.use_for: See context usage, active tools, subagents and todo progress in Claude Code
entries.why: Popular Claude Code plugin (135 contributors) that adds a live HUD without leaving the terminal.

entries.name: claude-mem
entries.use_for: Persist and recall context across agent sessions by capturing and compressing what the agent did.
entries.why: The most popular persistent-memory plugin for Claude Code; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Cloudflare skills
entries.use_for: Official skills for Workers, Wrangler, Durable Objects, Agents SDK and other Cloudflare products
entries.why: Official Cloudflare pack; cloudflare, wrangler and workers-best-practices each have 100k+ installs on skills.sh

entries.name: Codex plugin for Claude Code
entries.use_for: Call Codex from inside Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks
entries.why: Official OpenAI plugin bridging Codex and Claude Code for second-opinion reviews and background tasks.

entries.name: Compound Engineering
entries.use_for: Adopt a plan, work, review, compound loop for agentic engineering
entries.why: Every's widely used plugin for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; 108 contributors and a full brainstorm/plan/review skill set.

entries.name: diagram-design
entries.use_for: Have an agent produce editorial-quality diagrams across 44 diagram types
entries.why: About 14k skills.sh installs; supports Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and more.

entries.name: Everything Claude Code (ECC)
entries.use_for: Bundle skills, hooks, memory and security configs to tune an agent harness.
entries.why: Very widely starred harness configuration pack, actively maintained, MIT.

entries.name: Expo Skills
entries.use_for: Official Expo skills for building, deploying, upgrading and debugging Expo and React Native apps with an agent.
entries.why: Maintained by the Expo team and listed in the official Claude and Codex plugin marketplaces.

entries.name: hallmark
entries.use_for: Steer Claude Code, Cursor or Codex away from generic AI-looking UI
entries.why: About 63k skills.sh installs; opinionated design rules from Hassan El Mghari (Together AI).

entries.name: Humanizer
entries.use_for: Rewrite text to remove common signs of AI-generated writing.
entries.why: Focused, widely used writing skill (~58k stars), MIT.

entries.name: last30days
entries.use_for: Research what people said about a topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, HN and the web
entries.why: About 48k skills.sh installs; synthesizes recent community discussion into a cited brief.

entries.name: Marketing Skills
entries.use_for: Give agents marketing skills for SEO audits, CRO, copywriting, analytics and growth.
entries.why: Most-installed marketing skill pack (~230k installs for seo-audit); MIT.

entries.name: Matt Pocock skills
entries.use_for: Opinionated engineering skills: codebase design, interface design, git guardrails and TDD workflows
entries.why: One of the most-installed community skill packs on skills.sh (several skills above 200k installs) from a well-known TS educator

entries.name: NVIDIA skills
entries.use_for: Install agent skills for NVIDIA products and SDKs into Claude Code, Codex and others.
entries.why: Official NVIDIA-maintained skills for its developer stack.

entries.name: obsidian-skills
entries.use_for: Teach an agent Obsidian Flavored Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas and the Obsidian CLI
entries.why: By Obsidian CEO Steph Ango; ~90k installs for obsidian-markdown on skills.sh, with cli and bases skills close behind.

entries.name: planning-with-files
entries.use_for: Keep long-running agent tasks on track with persistent markdown plan, findings and progress files.
entries.why: Simple, crash-proof planning pattern with broad adoption (~27k stars).

entries.name: PM Skills
entries.use_for: Give an agent product-management workflows: PRDs, pre-mortems, prioritization, roadmaps
entries.why: 100+ PM skills and commands; top skills each around 10k installs on skills.sh.

entries.name: ponytail
entries.use_for: Push your agent toward the smallest change: write less code, review and audit for bloat
entries.why: About 94k skills.sh installs for the core skill, plus review/audit/debt skills; 127 contributors.

entries.name: Scientific Agent Skills
entries.use_for: Equip agents with scientific skills for bioinformatics, chemistry, data analysis and literature work.
entries.why: Largest science-focused skill library; ~52k stars, MIT.

entries.name: security-audit-skill
entries.use_for: Run a multi-phase security audit of a codebase with a coding agent
entries.why: Official Cloudflare skill; findings are independently verified and emitted as machine-readable output.

entries.name: skills CLI (find-skills)
entries.use_for: Install and discover agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others with npx skills add
entries.why: The open skills installer behind skills.sh; its find-skills skill is the most-installed skill on skills.sh (~3.9M installs)

entries.name: Supabase agent skills
entries.use_for: Teach coding agents Supabase and Postgres best practices for schema, RLS and queries.
entries.why: Official Supabase skills; ~448k installs on skills.sh for the Postgres best-practices skill.

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.use_for: Give a coding agent a disciplined workflow: brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging and code review skills.
entries.why: One of the most installed skill packs on skills.sh (~395k installs for brainstorming); MIT.

entries.name: Taste Skill
entries.use_for: Design-taste skills that steer agents away from generic AI-looking frontends
entries.why: Very widely installed design skill pack on skills.sh (~625k installs for design-taste-frontend)

entries.name: UI UX Pro Max
entries.use_for: Give a coding agent design intelligence: styles, palettes, font pairings and UX rules
entries.why: About 400k skills.sh installs; searchable database of UI styles, color palettes and stack-specific guidelines.

entries.name: Vercel Agent Skills
entries.use_for: Vercel skills for coding agents: React and Next.js best practices, web design guidelines and deployment.
entries.why: Official Vercel skill pack with some of the highest install counts on skills.sh.

license_verified.note: License stated as MIT in the README; no LICENSE file in the repo.

entries.name: wshobson/agents
entries.use_for: Add a large marketplace of subagents, skills and commands across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.
entries.why: Widely adopted multi-harness plugin marketplace with ~41k stars.
